summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing interim condensed consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications. The filing reports revenue growth to CAD 498.6 million for Q2 2026 and net income of CAD 27.9 million, with no special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. It is a routine periodic reporting disclosure by a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act, incorporated by reference into existing F-10 and S-8 registration statements. No transaction, recommendation, or deal terms are presented.
